tools.name: Claude
tools.quote: the university provides institutional access to Claude and Microsoft Copilot.
Tools for grammar and spell check (Grammarly, DeepL, Microsoft Word’s built-in editor) are generally fine.

safeguards.quote: Anthropic guarantees that data shared with Claude by LSE staff and students will not be used to train their models, which makes it safer to use compared to other AI chatbots.

legal.quote: LSE’s broader research guidance (PDF) highlights further aspects of AI usage. These include data privacy, copyright, and the environmental impact.
